LanguageData.HS_OtherHauler: {0} is active – multi-item hauling in Haul Smarter is off. Turn {0} off to use it.
LanguageData.HS_PocketHarvest: Harvest and wood straight into pockets
LanguageData.HS_UnloadAt: Unload when pockets are full to: {0}
LanguageData.HS_ProfileHint: Click a profile – it sets everything at once. Change anything and it switches to Custom.
LanguageData.HS_ProfGame_Card: Just several things at once, nothing else.
LanguageData.HS_ProfSmart_Card: Perishables first. Short route, things on the way, building from pockets.
LanguageData.HS_ProfMax_Card: Full pockets, long routes, valuables first.
LanguageData.HS_HaulMany_Desc: The colonist walks to every item nearby, puts it in his pockets and carries everything to storage. Storage is chosen for every item – shelves and deep storage work. What fits nowhere is put down next to him.
LanguageData.HS_MaxItems_Desc: How many different stacks at most in one trip.
LanguageData.HS_Radius_Desc: How far from the first item he looks for more.
LanguageData.HS_SmartRoute: Smart route (collect on the way, no zig-zag)
LanguageData.HS_SmartRoute_Desc: The order of items is chosen so the way from the colonist through all items to storage is as short as possible.
LanguageData.HS_Opportunistic_Desc: When a colonist walks somewhere or finishes a job, he puts a thing lying right next to him that belongs in storage into his pockets. Gently: adjacent cells only, one stack and then a pause, never while hurrying (firefighting, tending, fleeing, orders) and never above half of his capacity. He hauls it when idle or when the pockets are full.
LanguageData.HS_UnloadAt_Desc: For harvest, mining and things taken after other work: how full the pockets get before he goes to unload.
LanguageData.HS_PrioPerish_Desc: Things that rot and lie somewhere warm (meat, crops, meals).
LanguageData.HS_PrioWeather: Things outside in the rain / near fire
LanguageData.HS_PrioWeather_Desc: Things that deteriorate outdoors without a roof (medicine, textiles, weapons…), and things within 5 cells of fire.
LanguageData.HS_PocketHarvest_Desc: The colonist takes the crop or wood lying right next to him, keeps working and hauls it when the pockets are full or the work is done.
LanguageData.HS_PocketMine_Desc: The colonist takes mined stone and ore lying right next to him, keeps mining and hauls it when the pockets are full.
LanguageData.HS_BonusKg_Desc: How many kilos more than the game allows (0 = like the game).
LanguageData.HS_Slowdown_Desc: Above half of the capacity the colonist walks slower – up to 15 % with full pockets. Off by default.
LanguageData.HS_ShowWeight: Show weight on the colonist (bar above the head)
LanguageData.HS_ShowWeight_Desc: A small bar above a colonist carrying things to storage: green, orange, red by load. At the closest zoom also the kilos.
LanguageData.HS_ShowEta: Show weight and "how long until stored"
LanguageData.HS_ShowEta_Desc: Select a colonist and the bottom panel shows how much he carries, how many items he will still pick up and when it will be in storage.
LanguageData.HS_Overview_Desc: An overview window: what waits to be hauled, its weight, what rots, how many haulers, how long until done and who hauled how much.
LanguageData.HS_Highlight: Highlight unhauled things on the map
LanguageData.HS_Highlight_Desc: While the Hauling window is open, things waiting to be hauled are outlined on the map – yellow, and orange for those that rot or lie in the rain.
LanguageData.HS_InfoNote: Statistics (who hauled how much) are saved with the game. Hauling done by Haul Smarter is counted.
LanguageData.HS_OvWaiting: Waiting to be hauled: {0} stacks · {1} kg
LanguageData.HS_OvHot: Of that rotting: {0} · outside in rain / near fire: {1} · valuable: {2}
LanguageData.HS_OvEta: Done in about {0} (if they only hauled)
LanguageData.HS_OvEtaNone: Nothing to haul or nobody has hauling enabled.
LanguageData.HS_BuildPockets: Build with material from the pockets
LanguageData.HS_BuildPockets_Desc: When a colonist carries material a construction needs (wood, steel, stone…), he takes it out of his pockets and brings it straight to the site – no walk to the stockpile.
LanguageData.HS_CleanupNotice: The battle is over – {0} weapons, apparel and bodies lie around the base. Hauling overview → "Clean up after battle".
LanguageData.HS_CleanupNotice_Desc: A message says how many weapons, apparel and bodies lie around the base. Start the clean-up in the Hauling overview.
LanguageData.HS_CleanupAuto_Desc: After every battle at home, what the enemies left around the base is allowed and hauled first – no click needed.
LanguageData.HS_CleanupButton_Desc: Allows weapons, apparel and bodies lying around the base (the game forbids enemy gear) and has them hauled before everything else.
LanguageData.HS_CleanupStarted: Clean-up started: {0} things will be hauled first.
